thread:
incident-bot: Paging: High p99 latency observed for Sable Corp (VPC: vpc-sable-1) on dedicated pool 'sable-pool-2'. Error-rate spike and tail latency starting ~09:12 UTC. Auto-attach runbook: /runbooks/vpc-noisy-tenant. Please ACK and join if you can. :rotating_light:

emily (oncall-sre): ack — I’m on it. Pulling logs and checking pool isolation now.

matt (eng-oncall): thanks Emily — quick Q: noisy tenant vs infra? if tenant noisy we can isolate and migrate.

emily (oncall-sre): initial grep shows one tenant (tenant-id: t-9f3b) with sustained high requests and a KV cache miss spike. Starting isolation flow (mv-evict).

raj (eng-runtime): pinged. Suggest a short router-level throttle for that tenant while we migrate. Less blast radius.

emily (oncall-sre): applied rate-limit rule via admin tool:
```
redwoodctl tenant throttle --tenant t-9f3b --rate 500r/s --duration 10m
```
p95 improved ~35% within 2 minutes. Kicking off live-migration to standby pool.

jordan (prod-ops-bot): Job 76821: started migration of tenant t-9f3b from sable-pool-2 -> sable-standby-1. ETA ~4m.

sarah (csm-sable): FYI Sable support (sarah@sable.com) is watching. They've reported intermittent timeouts and want ETA. I'll keep them posted.

emily (oncall-sre): migration complete. Verified KV cache warmup and traffic routing. p95/p99 back to baseline. No other tenants impacted. Marking mitigated.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Quick summary: noisy tenant exhausting KV cache + aggressive batching. Runbook steps executed: throttle, migrate, cache warmup. Severity set to P2.

david (security): quick question — any firewall rule or external IP changes during migration? need to confirm no external drift for Sable VPC.

emily (oncall-sre): no firewall or external IP edits. All changes were internal routing and tenant assignment. Confirmed via config-audit logs.

matt (eng-oncall): Emily — can you draft a short post-incident note for CSM with bullets: RCA, what we did, and immediate next steps? Also flag if we need an exec-level update for Sable CTO.

emily (oncall-sre): drafting now. Proposed offering Sable a 10% credit for this billing period given the user-facing timeouts — thoughts?

raj (eng-runtime): +1 on 10%. Also recommend we add auto-throttle when KV-miss rate exceeds threshold; I'll open a high-priority ticket.

sarah (csm-sable): 10% sounds reasonable to the customer. They want an RCA by EOD and prevention plan. I'll forward the draft once you post it here.

olivia (eng-release): follow-up: schedule a nightly canary for cache-warmup fix on sable-pool-2 and include it in next release notes pending QA.

emily (oncall-sre): draft RCA (below) — please review/edit before I send to Sarah to forward to Sable:
```
- Summary: On 2026-03-15 09:12 UTC, Sable experienced elevated tail latency originating from dedicated pool sable-pool-2 due to tenant t-9f3b producing sustained heavy request volume while the KV cache was cold.
- Impact: Intermittent timeouts and elevated p95/p99 for Sable's VPC for ~15 minutes during peak traffic.
- Root cause: Tenant-level traffic surge combined with cache miss amplification and aggressive batching logic in runtime.
- Mitigations performed: applied tenant-level throttle, migrated the tenant to standby pool, warmed KV cache, monitored until metrics stabilized.
- Post-incident actions: implement auto-throttle based on KV-miss threshold, add e2e cache warmup test, schedule canary for the fix, offer 10% invoice credit, provide RCA and exec summary to Sable CTO.
```

matt (eng-oncall): looks good — add a concise timeline with exact timestamps and the commands executed to be transparent.

emily (oncall-sre): added timeline + command snippets. Sending draft to Sarah now and opening follow-up tickets.

sarah (csm-sable): received. Sable asked if we can run a 30-minute technical bridge tomorrow to walk through the fixes and prevention plan. Requesting Raj + Olivia on the bridge.

raj (eng-runtime): I can join the bridge.

olivia (eng-release): I’ll join for release plan context.

incident-bot: Follow-ups created — ENG-5421 (auto-throttle), ENG-5422 (cache-warmup-tests), CSE-210 (customer comm + credit). Owners: raj, olivia, sarah.

emily (oncall-sre): handing off follow-ups. Oncall handing over for overnight watch to matt.

matt (eng-oncall): taking handoff. Will monitor next 6 hours and escalate for any regression. Good work, team. :thumbsup:
